svg.title: Acoustic end-to-end pipeline v2 master topology
svg.desc: Four dataset-native lanes feed the current adjustable shared-window benchmark policy, one selected frozen candidate encoder, a shared projector, and dataset-native heads. Engineering readiness and performance evidence are separated.
svg.text: Four native units → current shared-window policy (16 kHz / 2 s / 1 s; adjustable) → frozen encoder → shared projector → native heads | not performance

text.tspan: paper tasks: I, E, CAS, DAS one-vs-rest
retain Nw sequence; no mean pool
no official split · group by P-number
same 2 s candidate encoder per window
→ native temporal4; no temporal mean pooling
opens legal head; never reads target at inference
I / E / CAS / DAS native objectives

svg.text: TRAINING / EVALUATION CONTROL PLANE — lateral controls, not sequential audio modules

text.tspan: only eligible native losses and metric rows
inference uses declared capability, not target labels
W16 SG-SCL · W18 PAFA · W26 ADD-RSC
one preregistered intervention point at a time
per dataset · per unit · per class · worst dataset

svg.text: CURRENT EXECUTION ROADMAP — local readiness only; all performance results remain NOT RUN
